summary: Mainstream Indian cricket (Arshdeep, Hardik, IPL) and major entertainment buzz (Yash in Ramayana) drive over 80% of total channel views and engagement. Generic financial news, obscure international athletes, and vague lifestyle updates consistently flopped below 100 views. To reach monetisation velocity, shift 80% of channel production exclusively to Tier-1 cricket and marquee pop-culture, pairing Devanagari titles with strong tension-driven visual hooks.
do_more: Double down on active Indian cricket drama, IPL updates, and mega Indian movie reveals
Feature globally recognizable household names like Rohit, Hardik, Arshdeep, and Ronaldo
Use Devanagari Hindi text with English keywords in titles rather than pure Roman Hinglish
Open videos with an exact record, unexpected score, or visual shock in the first 2 seconds
avoid: Covering niche global football players like Brajan Gruda or minor tennis news
Producing stock market, commodity price, or civic ranking updates
Writing low-context Romanized titles like 'Debutant ka Dhamaka'
Covering speculative automotive or far-future fantasy timelines like 2026-2027 car sales
hook_tips: Start with a hard shock stat: 'Kya No. 11 batsman match bacha sakta hai?'
Address the superstar directly: 'Rohit Sharma ka yeh faisla sabko chaukane wala tha'
Create an open curiosity gap: 'Ronaldo apni iconic Jersey No. 7 kyu chhod rahe hain?'
Anchor immediate stakes within 1.5 seconds instead of saying channel intros or greetings
title_tips: Mix Devanagari script for emotional punch with English for searchable names
Include surprising numbers or exact match situations in the first 30 characters
Use punchy punctuation like exclamation marks and question marks without misleading claims
Keep the main keyword up front before the #Shorts tag (e.g., 'Arshdeep Singh Record: नंबर 11 पर छक्का!')
